# ZOMBI2

> ZOMBI2 simulates the evolution of species trees, genomes, sequences and traits, each on its own,
> conditioned on another, or jointly, and records the true history behind every dataset. Pure
> Python, `pip install zombi2`, MIT.

An agent that will use ZOMBI2 in a project starts here, one file that installs it and says how it is
driven: https://aadavin.github.io/zombi2/docs/agent-setup/prompt.txt
